# Instructional Biology

> Biotechnology company in Oceanside, California, founded in 2026 by Boris Markosian, founder, CEO and sole inventor. Instructional Biology is developing Instructional Medicine: therapeutics made from the body's own native signaling proteins, kept intact from discovery to delivery, so they can instruct cells instead of forcing a single receptor. The technology is patent-pending and pre-clinical; no Instructional Biology product is approved for clinical use.

## What Instructional Biology is building
Five connected systems, each designed to be licensable on its own:
- ASAP (Advanced Science AI Platform): biology-native AI that maps how the body's signals interact, on a hyperbolic (Poincaré ball) Signaling Cascade Knowledge Graph.
- MHFBP (Markosian High-Fidelity Bio-Processing Protocol): low-temperature bioprocessing designed to keep proteins in their native, folded state.
- ISRS-ML: pathogen reduction with light in continuous flow, without the heat that damages delicate biologics.
- MET-APFS (Markosian Exosomal Transcytosis - Autonomic Pharmacokinetic Feedback System): an exosome carrier configured for the individual patient, and a dosing loop that adapts in real time inside limits a prescriber signs.
- Patient digital twin: a model of one person, updated from wearable data and kept inside clinician-set limits.

## ASAP in numbers (November 5, 2026; trained ball frozen November 4, 2026)
- Signaling Cascade Knowledge Graph (SCKG): 13,090 nodes and 35,446 edges, built from 21,425 PubMed papers and 12,014 clinical trials.
- Tiers: the TSP at the center, native signaling constituents, receptors, signaling-cascade nodes and master regulators, 999 diseases and 4,749 disease phenotypes.
- Trained 128-dimensional Poincaré ball; mean distortion 0.0469 on held-out node pairs, within the 0.05 gate.
- 33,024 x 64 trained tangent angles (64 rotation planes per signed edge); tangent spaces viewable in 2D and 3D.
- 351,890 computational simulations: every pairing scored by the trained network for predicted benefit or harm.
- 19,251 novel predicted benefits across 202 diseases and 2,207 disease phenotypes, where the record has no direct link, no shared paper and no tested trial; 14,269 contraindications flagged across all pairs scored.
- 36 demo patient digital twins (simulated subjects).
- All computational results, not clinical results.

## Status
- Six U.S. patent applications filed in 2026, naming Boris Markosian as sole inventor, including U.S. Patent Application No. 19/793,487.
- Pre-clinical. Nothing on this site is medical advice or a claim that any product treats, cures or prevents a disease.

## Partnerships and licensing
Pharmaceutical companies, contract manufacturers, trial sponsors and research institutions can license a single technology without adopting the whole platform: [Partnerships and Licensing](https://www.instructionalbiology.com/about/partnerships/)
